text:
mira: Heads-up — we need to finalize the list of runtime metrics and the egress/KMS/audit requirements for Private metrics export. Customers on VPC/on-prem are blocked until we align. Who can own this?

sam: I can drive the infra side. Quick checklist: agent outbound only, supports proxy, currently talks to metrics-collector.redwood.com:443 and optionally 8443 for legacy. Need to confirm IP ranges and support for mTLS.

john: From runtime: available metrics we can emit now: token_latency_ms (p50/p95/p99), tokens_per_request, batch_size, kv_cache_hit_rate, model_version, gpu_util_pct. We can tag by deployment_id, host_id, model_name.

anya: For dashboards we need stable metric names and labels: please include customer_id, env (prod/staging), model_family, and a rollout_tag for canary vs stable. Also we rely on a reliable counter for dropped_requests and fallback_count.

lee: Security notes: agent performs envelope encryption for sensitive payloads. For KMS we need to support both: (1) calls to a customer-managed KMS endpoint (over TLS) and (2) local HSM via PKCS#11. We must document that agent requires outbound TLS to KMS endpoint and (if using customer KMS) will include key_id in headers. Audit hooks: agent can POST audit events to customer syslog/HTTP endpoint — those should be optional and configurable.

sam: Firewall specifics: minimal outbound egress to collector host on 443. If using customer KMS, agent must reach their KMS host on 443. If proxy is present, agent uses HTTP proxy env vars. For customers that disallow external egress, we support a pull-mode where collector polls the agent (requires opening inbound port 9191) — note this is less common and requires extra network review.

mira: Can you paste a sample agent config snippet we can share with customers/solutions?

sam: Sure — gist for docs:
```yaml
agent:
  mode: push # push | pull
  collector: https://metrics-collector.redwood.com
  proxy: ${HTTP_PROXY:-}
  egress_ports: [443]
  k8s_service_account: redwood-agent
  tls:
    client_cert: optional
    ca_bundle: /etc/redwood/ca.pem
  audit_hook: https://customer-siem.example.com/audit
```

john: One runtime caveat: kv_cache_hit_rate is sampled per-request; if you need 1s granularity we'll need to bump emission frequency and add a small overhead check — call that out in docs.

anya: For the dashboard team I'll map those metrics to panels: latency histograms, cache hit trend, tokens per request, fallback_rate, export_success_rate (counts of successful pushes). Also want per-deployment breakdown for rollouts.

lee: Also: log retention. On-prem customers may require audit logs to stay for X days — agent supports local retention and upload to S3-compatible endpoints. Make sure we document S3 sigv4 vs local HSM signing differences.

mira: Action items: 1) sam: publish firewall + proxy matrix + sample config (ETA Tue). 2) john: confirm emission cadence and any perf cost for high-frequency metrics (ETA Wed). 3) lee: write KMS and audit hook security doc (ETA Thu). 4) anya: draft dashboard wireframes and metric mapping (ETA Thu). I'll coordinate a short review on Friday.

sam: acked. I'll add the IP ranges and a note on pull-mode tradeoffs. :thumbsup:

john: ack, will measure cost on a small cluster and post numbers in the thread.

lee: ack — will include recommended TLS cipher suites and mutual auth options.
